Full summary: Drafted the foundation programme plan of record (docs/plans/2026-09-15-foundation-programme-plan.md) for the twining-foundation-20260915 package: baseline pinned, all 7 supplied gaps confirmed at source, 5 stages, 7 rulings pending Dave.

Findings: Baseline 2026-09-15 at HEAD d7860e0 (= the package's inspected commit): npx vitest run → 119 files, 1725 passed, 2 skipped, 16.9s. Claude Code 2.1.272, Node 25.8.1. Codex CLI is NOT on PATH here (cmux shim reports not found); ChatGPT.app carries a bundled Codex runtime (bundleVersion 26.909.12148) and ~/.codex/auth.json exists.; All seven source-evidence.md gap rows are CONFIRMED present at d7860e0 by direct reading (hooks.json has no PreCompact/compact matcher; subagent-stop posts a generic status; assemble unions scope-prefix with semantic over the whole active/provisional set; provenance is the project root's branch/sha; staleness is local-only; decide accepts status+agent_id and promote attribution is caller-supplied; formatter 3+2 tier with 4-char estimate; export rewrites in place with file-wins ingest). None refuted; runtime reproduction with positive controls is Stage 0 task B1.; The in-flight CLI work is a field-driven MCP-whitelist workaround (blackboard 01M23Y66KB2E2QX219RVX608XJ, urgent, 2026-09-09); the assessment stopped at research with no design document. It shares the transport-agnostic command core with the programme's host-adapter lane (R10/R11) — scheduling is ruling RB1.; warning: every session on this machine serves this repo's dist/ via the npm link — running `npm run build` in the main checkout on a v3 branch would make v3 server code serve v2 stores in other sessions. Plan assumption A11: no dist builds in the main checkout during the programme; builds in worktrees/scratch; v3 must refuse to serve a v2 store without explicit migrate.; `timeout` is not available on macOS zsh here (coreutils absent) — wrapping vitest in `timeout 900` fails with 'command not found'; use the Bash tool's own timeout parameter instead.; The W2/2.17.0 and 2.17.1 drafted plans overlap heavily with R07/R08/R15/R16/R19 (assemble disclosure, budget order, payload measurement, sync-state disclosure, createSuperseding, ingest counters); absorption vs ship-first is ruling RB2.
